description: A 8-channel stereo mixer with panning, muting and a mix bus other mixers can be chained into

params.text: Sets the level of the whole mix, starting at 80 per cent
Sets that channel's level, silent at the bottom of its travel and unity at the top; it starts at 80 per cent
Places that channel across the stereo field, hard left to hard right
Silences that channel, and stays down until it is pressed again
Silences the whole mix, the signals arriving at the MIX IN jacks included

inputs.text: Scales the whole mix, 0V to 10V; with nothing patched the mix fader alone sets it
Scales that channel's level, 0V to 10V; with nothing patched the fader alone sets it
Added to that channel's PAN knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Sums a left signal from another mixer into this one's stereo mix; it is summed in only while the right MIX IN jack is patched as well
Sums a right signal from another mixer into this one's stereo mix; it is summed in only while the left MIX IN jack is patched as well

outputs.text: The stereo mix, left; with the right output unpatched this jack carries left and right summed instead
That channel on its own after its fader, pan and mute, with left and right summed

notes: The MIX IN jacks take the stereo output of another mixer, so several mixers can be chained together without spending a channel on it.
